title: Electroencephalography Signal Processing: A Comprehensive Review and Analysis of Methods and Techniques
authors: Ahmad Chaddad; Yihang Wu; Reem Kateb; Ahmed Bouridane; Chang-Hwan Im; Yvonne Tran
task: general EEG signal processing (pipeline overview; applications incl. epilepsy, motor imagery, emotion, sleep, stroke, depression)
datasets: DEAP; SEED; BCI Competition IV 2a; Bonn; CHB-MIT; Siena; Sleep-EDF
concepts: independent-component-analysis; time-frequency-analysis; signal-quality-and-noise; frequency-bands; evaluation-protocols; consumer-grade-eeg-devices; channel-heterogeneity

title: Large Brain Model for Learning Generic Representations with Tremendous EEG Data in BCI
authors: Wei-Bang Jiang; Li-Ming Zhao; Bao-Liang Lu
task: abnormal EEG detection; EEG event classification; emotion recognition; gait regression
n_channels: variable (one patch per channel per 1 s; ≤256 patches)
model_type: Transformer foundation model; masked prediction of VQ neural-tokenizer codes
eval_protocol: cross-subject (patient-level split) on TUAB/TUEV; pooled-subject trial split on SEED-V
main_result: TUEV bal. acc. 0.6409 (Base) vs BIOT 0.5281; TUAB 0.8140 vs 0.7959 (Tables 1–2)
concepts: time-frequency-analysis; frequency-bands; self-supervised-pretraining; channel-heterogeneity; cnn-transformer-hybrid; evaluation-protocols; signal-quality-and-noise

title: Wireless EEG: A survey of systems and studies
authors: Guiomar Niso; Elena Romero; Jeremy T. Moreau; Alvaro Araujo; Laurens R. Krol
task: survey: wireless EEG hardware (48 devices) and its research use (110 studies)
main_result: 48 devices compared on ~35 specs (Table 1); 110 high-impact studies: cognitive monitoring 44%, clinical 24%, methodological 22%, control/communication 10% (Fig. 7a)

title: A scoping review on the use of consumer-grade EEG devices for research
authors: Joshua Sabio; Nikolas Williams; Genevieve M. McArthur; Nicholas A. Badcock
task: scoping review: research use of consumer-grade EEG devices
main_result: 916 studies (531 journal, 385 conference); Emotiv used in 67.69% (Abstract; §Consumer-grade EEG devices)

title: EEG Conformer: Convolutional Transformer for EEG Decoding and Visualization
authors: Yonghao Song; Qingqing Zheng; Bingchuan Liu; Xiaorong Gao
venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Systems and Rehabilitation Engineering, vol. 31 (2023)
datasets: BCI Competition IV 2a; BCI Competition IV 2b; SEED
eval_protocol: within-subject (session split on 2a/2b; 5-fold CV on SEED)
main_result: 78.66% mean acc., kappa 0.7155 on BCI IV-2a vs EEGNet 74.50% (Table II)
concepts: frequency-bands; cnn-transformer-hybrid; evaluation-protocols; signal-quality-and-noise; channel-heterogeneity; self-supervised-pretraining
